definition: In Codice Ratio is a research project designed to study and use novel techniques such as Optical Character Recognition and Artificial Intelligence to digitize works in the Vatican Apostolic Archive, most of which is handwritten.
details: In Codice Ratio is a research project designed to study and use novel techniques such as Optical Character Recognition and Artificial Intelligence to digitize works in the Vatican Apostolic Archive, most of which is handwritten.

explainer.lead: In Codice Ratio is a research project applying OCR and AI to digitize works in the Vatican Apostolic Archive, most of which are handwritten. It matters because it targets large collections of handwriting that standard OCR cannot handle.

tiers.eli5: It's a project using computers to read old handwritten documents in the Vatican archives and turn them into digital text.
tiers.practitioner: Researchers build OCR and AI pipelines tuned for handwritten historical documents rather than printed text. A pitfall is that handwriting variability and historical scripts break tools designed for clean print.
tiers.paperLevel: The project studies and applies techniques such as optical character recognition and artificial intelligence to digitize handwritten holdings of the Vatican Apostolic Archive. Its limits stem from the difficulty of recognizing handwriting at scale.

explainer.example: A handwritten archival page is processed by the project's OCR and AI pipeline to produce a digitized, searchable text version.
